conventions.own-skill-relative: Inside a skill directory, references/, agents/, templates/ and examples/ resolve against that skill directory. scripts/ also resolves there when the skill ships its own scripts/ directory (sr-screener).
conventions.payload-root-relative: shared/, scripts/, docs/, tools/, MODE_REGISTRY.md and <skill-name>/... resolve against the payload root.
conventions.claude-plugin-root: ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/... resolves against the payload root (the Claude Code variable is expanded away).
conventions.skill-mirror: A root-level agents/<name>.md that mirrors exactly one <skill>/agents/<name>.md resolves its skill-local references against that mirrored skill.
conventions.file-relative-link: A Markdown link target that fails the primary convention is also tried relative to the containing file; upstream shared/ documents link this way.
